'''Lega Fossang''' was a [[human]] [[Resistance pilot]]. After being recruited into the [[Resistance]] from a [[planet]]ary [[Humbarine planetary defense force|defense force]] on [[Humbarine]], Fossang brought her [[BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighter|Y-wing fighter]] with her. [[L4E-R5]], an [[R5 series astromech droid]], served as her ship's [[astromech droid]]. She marked her [[First Order]] [[TIE series|TIE]] [[Death|kill]] count on her [[helmet]]s, having entirely filled up two.<ref name="TROS VD" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lega Fossang first appeared in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> where she was portrayed by<ref name="Instagram">{{Instagram|username=lucyfengofficial|url=p/CzKNU4Rt0Jb|name=[[Lucy Feng]]|date=2023-11-02|quote=Lega Fossang - Y wing pilot from Rise of Skywalker, who featured in the visual dictionary accompanying the film. The above photo was taken by the incredible @olleyjonathan|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/UCKK6}}</ref> uncredited<ref name="TROS" /> actor [[Lucy Feng]].<ref name="Instagram" /> She remained unidentified in the film,<ref name="TROS" /> but was named in ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''.<ref name="TROS VD" />
